Eye closest to Metro Manila tonight through dawn? My analysis: 7PM-7AM window. Act NOW to mitigate risks!

🔴RED WARNING : Rizal, Metro Manila, Laguna, Bulacan, Quezon incl. Candelaria, Infanta, Lucena, etc. Cavite (Cavite City, Dasmariñas, Imus, etc.).

Bataan Dinalupihan, etc. Prep sandbags, secure homes—climate patterns show these events intensifying, linked to warmer oceans.

‘BUKAS PO ANG SIMBAHAN’

As Super Typhoon #UwanPH batters the country, the Santa Lucia Parish in Novaliches, Quezon City opens its doors on Sunday, Nov. 9, to provide refuge for residents seeking higher ground from rising floodwaters.

“Bukas po ang Simbahan ng Santa Lucia upang patuluyin ang ating mga kapatid nasalanta ng baha dahil sa bagyong Uwan,” the parish said on its Facebook page.

Rev. Fr. Marvin Riquez, parish priest of Santa Lucia, said they will also serve hot meals to evacuees and have mobilized parish volunteers to assist in the relief efforts. (📸: SANTA LUCIA PARISH FB PAGE) | via Jel Santos

data.raw_text:
How's everyone's weekend going, @ofc_the_club  community? 😎
The past week was quite tough for people in countries hit by typhoon Kalmaegi, like the Philippines and Vietnam. Despite that, with our passion, @divzkie1206  and I still managed to arrange and bring to the @ofc_the_club  community this wonderful interview below. 💪
Read it, feel it, and see why @divzkie1206 is always one of the top Super Fans. 🫡
Let's go! 💥

_____________________________________________________

1. Please give a brief introduction about yourself
- I'm Divine from the Philippines, a proud mom of two. 😊

2. Which football team and player are you a fan of?
- I’m a die-hard fan of Liverpool FC. My favorite player is Cristiano Ronaldo – his discipline, mentality, and longevity in the game are truly unmatched

3. Is there any special detail or accessory you'd like to add to your @OneFootball Head? Please describe it and the benefits you hope to gain
- I’d love to customize my @OneFootball  Head with a Liverpool jersey featuring my name on the back and a small @OneFootball Club logo on the sleeve.
It’s a simple yet powerful touch that represents loyalty, pride, and unwavering passion. Equipping it would give me an extra boost of confidence, team spirit, and motivation every time I represent the club

4. As far as I know, you are the first female super fan of the project. Do you have any thoughts or feelings about this?
- Yes, I’m incredibly proud to be among the first batch of Super Fans. 🥰
It was completely unexpected – back then, there wasn’t even any information about the “Super Fan” program, so being selected felt surreal. This title means more than just recognition; it’s about being part of a global family united by a shared love for football and Web3. It motivates me to stay active, support the community, and embody the true spirit of @ofc_the_club in everything I do. ❤️*

5. What would you do with 10K $OFC tokens if we assume that's the airdrop amount you receive from the project?
- As soon as staking becomes available, my plan is to stake all 10K $OFC tokens – and possibly add even more to my holdings. I genuinely believe in the massive long-term potential of $OFC, driven by the project’s clear vision, vibrant community energy, and strategic direction. Holding and staking feels like the smartest way to contribute to and grow with the ecosystem
----------------------------------------------------------
### Quick-Fire Round

6. What is your favorite food?
- My favorite food is Humba, a classic Filipino dish

7. What is your favorite song?
- “The Climb” by Miley Cyrus

8. Can you share the emoji you like to use the most?
-🥰

9. If you could travel abroad, where would you most want to go?
-England

10. Which foreign language do you most want to learn?
- Korean

11. What is your favorite color?
- Maroon
----------------------------------------------------------
### Deeper Questions

12. What feature would you like @OneFootball app to add specifically for their female fans?
- The app is already inclusive and excellent for all users, but one meaningful addition could be a dedicated community section showcasing inspiring stories of women in football – from players and coaches to fans and creators. It would celebrate female contributions and further empower women within the global football community

13. Do you currently have any suggestions to help make the project better?
- The team is already doing an outstanding job keeping the community engaged and informed. If I were to suggest one enhancement, it would be to forge stronger collaborations or partnerships with local football communities and football - related content creators worldwide. This would bridge @OneFootball's global vision with grassroots passion, delivering more localized, relatable experiences for fans everywhere

14. What do you want the community to remember you for the most?
- I want to be remembered for my genuine passion, consistency, and unwavering belief in the @ofc_the_club  vision. Not just for being active, but for spreading positivity, uplifting others, and truly embodying what it means to be part of the #OFC family – a supporter who shows up, no matter what

15. Finally, do you have any message you’d like to send to the community?
- To my @ofc_the_club  family: Thank you for the endless support and the unbreakable spirit we’ve built together.
This journey taught me that being part of @ofc_the_club is more than just cheering for football, it’s about believing in something bigger. We’re here not just as fans, but as believers in a vision that connects passion, community, and purpose.
No matter the challenges, always believe in OFC. What we’re creating transcends the pitch – it’s history in the making. Let’s keep pushing forward, together.❤️
_____________________________________________________

Hey everyone, this was an absolutely flawless interview – zero flaws, nothing to criticize. Anyone who dares to nitpick it? Instant block from me! 👊👊

Let’s shower @divzkie1206 with our deepest, most heartfelt thanks. Wishing her, her two little ones, and her entire family endless warmth, rock-solid health, and limitless success on every path she chooses. 🫶🫶

The next interview will be just as epic – stay tuned, because it’s dropping soon! 🥳

Inoperate ng MMDA Flood Control and Sewerage Management Office ang mga mobile pumps sa Sucat, Parañaque City,  Ortigas Avenue Extension sa Pasig City, at bahagi ng Maynila, sa gitna ng malakas na pagbuhos ng ulan dala ng #UwanPH.

Ang paggamit ng mobile pumps ay upang maiwasan ang pagbaha, lalo na sa mga lugar na madaling bahain. 

Sa pamamagitan nito, mabilis na nailabas ang tubig-baha mula sa kalsada patungo sa mas malalaking daluyan ng tubig, tulad ng mga ilog at estero, upang maiwasan ang pagtaas ng lebel ng tubig.
#mmda #mmdaatyourservice
data.cleaned_text: Inoperate ng MMDA Flood Control and Sewerage Management Office ang mga mobile pumps sa Sucat, Parañaque City, Ortigas Avenue Extension sa Pasig City, at bahagi ng Maynila, sa gitna ng malakas na pagbuhos ng ulan dala ng #UwanPH. Ang paggamit ng mobile pumps ay upang maiwasan ang pagbaha, lalo na sa mga lugar na madaling bahain. Sa pamamagitan nito, mabilis na nailabas ang tubig-flood mula sa kalsada patungo sa mas malalaking daluyan ng tubig, tulad ng mga ilog at estero, upang maiwasan ang pagtaas ng lebel ng tubig. #mmda #mmdaatyourservice
data.english_translation: The MMDA Flood Control and Sewerage Management Office operated on mobile pumps in Sucat, Parañaque City, Orhard Avenue Extension in Pasig City, and part of Manila, amid the heavy downpour of #UwanPH. The use of mobile pumps is to prevent flooding, especially in easy flood areas. By means of this, water was quickly released from the road to larger vessels, such as rivers and ditches, to prevent the rising of levy.
